exposure: Time from placental separation to second-line therapy
cohort: 87 women who underwent cesarean delivery and received uterotonics after placental separation at the Beijing Haidian Maternal and Child Health Hospital, China, between 2009 and 2013
finding: Intrauterine gauze tamponade or B-Lynch suture were effective second-line treatments for severe postpartum hemorrhage at cesarean delivery, with gauze tamponade potentially being more effective in cases with blood loss exceeding 700 mL.
